retrievalProfile.description: A rugged, low-angle portrait of a male figure in western attire seated in a leather chair within a vast desert landscape, featuring high-contrast condensed typography.
triggerTerms: condensed block lettering with script subtitle

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male subject in a white shirt and black cowboy hat sits relaxed in a brown leather wingback chair. The chair is placed on cracked desert earth under a clear blue-to-teal gradient sky. Large, white, condensed sans-serif text dominates the lower right quadrant, paired with a smaller handwritten script on a dark rectangular bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject seated diagonally to create depth
Text anchored to the bottom right corner
Contrast between the warm leather tones and cool sky
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subject's boots and stature
coreInvariants: Condensed sans-serif display type with sharp corners
Leather armchair as a central prop in an outdoor setting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left and center-left, scaled to fill approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large condensed surname in the bottom right acts as the primary visual weight opposite the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face, down the leg to the boot, then rightward to the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky in the top right and expansive desert floor in the background provide breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (brown, tan, ochre) from the chair and ground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep teal and blue in the sky gradient.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white in the shirt and primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white shirt/text and the dark leather/hat.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' and 'C' have very small openings
The 'A' has a high horizontal crossbar

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored to the base of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, industrial condensed sans-serif with a fluid, personal script.
graphicDevices: Dark brown rectangular background bar for the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the primary name.
Approximates the casual, handwritten feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a cowboy hat and white shirt sitting in a brown leather armchair in a cracked desert landscape under a teal sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, extra-condensed uppercase sans-serif text in the bottom right. Below it, add a dark brown horizontal bar containing white script text.

verificationChecks: Is the subtitle contained within a dark bar?
Is the ground texture cracked earth?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact logo placements
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the horizon line is low in the frame
Verify the color contrast between text and background
Confirm the script text is centered within its bar
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Western/Rugged) + Setting(Desert/Outdoor) + Prop(Classic Furniture) + Typography(Condensed Sans + Script Overlay)
